job: Let one child take the space left over in a row.
purpose: A flex-grow helper: put it on the child of a row or stack that should absorb the remaining space, pushing its siblings to the ends. On an fd-divider it makes a rule that fills the row.
useWhen: A title should push its actions to the far end of a row.
A rule must fill the space on either side of an "or".

avoidWhen.when: A band must fill the height of a centred screen.
avoidWhen.instead: The data-grow attribute on the shell band; see the shell docs.

parts.role: The class on the child that grows.
